Estonian

[edit]
Estonian Wikipedia has an article on:
allergia
Wikipedia et

Etymology

[edit]

From German Allergie, coined from Ancient Greek ἄλλος (állos, “other”) + ἔργον (érgon, “work, activity”), originally as an antonym to German Energie (“energy”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɑlˈlerɡ̊iɑ̯/, [ɑlˈlerɡ̊iɑ̯]
  • Rhymes: -erɡiɑ
  • Hyphenation: al‧ler‧gia

Noun

[edit]

allergia (genitive allergia, partitive allergiat)

  1. allergy (hypersensitivity to a substance) [with (genitive +) vastu or (genitive +) suhtes ‘to what’]
    Synonym: (purist) ülitundlikkus
  2. allergy (antipathy toward a person or activity) [with (genitive +) vastu or (genitive +) suhtes ‘to what’]
